sources.label: Morphe patches for streaming and news phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, attribution, and audience-measurement services.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Stops the Play Store rating request.
Removes the "Sale" bar in articles, the Subscribe links, and the subscription pop-ups.
Removes the ads in the feeds, articles, galleries, and videos, and the ad-free upsells.
